from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u070/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    one = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1)
    two = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2)
    r, c = one
    tr, tc = two
    dr = 1 if tr > r else -1
    dc = 1 if tc > c else -1
    diagonal = min(abs(tr - r), abs(tc - c)) - 1
    for _ in range(diagonal):
        r += dr
        c += dc
        out[r][c] = 3
    while abs(tr - r) > 1 or abs(tc - c) > 1:
        if abs(tr - r) > abs(tc - c):
            r += dr
        else:
            c += dc
        out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
p=programs/'task-4dbdf9d8.py'
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(p), 'exec'), globals())
# check predicted 3 coordinates for four demos
